title: Poder and Conseguir — Permission and Ability
module: Módulo 4 — Planos, capacidade e ações em andamento
main_grammar: usos básicos de poder e conseguir.

student.lets_begin: Produce at least five accurate sentences and answer at least three questions on the topic “Things you can do and permission you need” using this lesson’s target structure.
student.basic_rule: Poder expresses permission/possibility; conseguir expresses ability or achieving a result.
student.english_comparison: English can covers multiple meanings; Portuguese distinguishes them.

multiple_choice.instruction: Choose one option for each meaning; say the chosen sentence aloud.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “May I come in?”?
Which sentence expresses “I can speak Portuguese.”?
Which sentence expresses “She can help today.”?
Which sentence expresses “We manage to study together.”?

gap_fill.instruction: Complete the missing target form. The English meaning is provided to remove ambiguity; read each whole sentence aloud.

mini_reading.instruction: Read the text aloud. Then answer the questions in full sentences.
mini_reading.text: Hoje eu posso estudar em casa. Minha irmã não pode sair, porque trabalha. Ela consegue estudar à noite. Meu amigo consegue falar português. Você pode abrir a porta? Posso, sim. Nós conseguimos terminar a atividade juntos.
questions: Por que a irmã não pode sair?
O que você consegue fazer bem?

review.another_way_to_understand_it: Ask whether the issue is permission, possibility or actually being able to do it.
review.compare: Posso entrar? / Consigo entrar.: permission versus capability.

oral_substitution_drill.instruction: Start from the base sentence. Say the new sentence in Portuguese for the English cue, without writing it first.

translate.instruction: Translate into Portuguese and say each sentence aloud.

fill_in.instruction: Fill the missing form in a two-clause context; say both sentences together. The English hint gives the meaning of the second sentence.

items.sentence: Nós conseguimos estudar juntos. Ela ________ ajudar hoje.
Você pode abrir a porta? Nós ________ estudar juntos.
Eles conseguem correr rápido. Você ________ abrir a porta?

listen_and_translate.instruction: Listen to three short utterances read by your teacher. Say the meaning in English, then repeat each utterance aloud.

reading_aloud_and_translation.instruction: Read the text aloud, translate it orally into English, then answer the questions.
reading_aloud_and_translation.text: Ana quer entrar na sala. Ela pergunta: “Posso entrar?” O professor responde: “Pode.” Pedro consegue ler em português, mas não consegue falar muito. Nós podemos ajudar Pedro. Ele consegue entender perguntas simples.
questions: O que Ana pergunta ao professor?
Pedro consegue falar muito em português?

speaking_practice.instruction: Answer in order: factual answers first, then personal examples and explanations. All answers are spoken in full sentences.

questions.question: Você consegue falar português?
questions.english: Can you manage to speak Portuguese?

questions.question: O que você consegue fazer bem?
questions.english: What can you manage to do well?

questions.question: O que você pode fazer hoje, mas não consegue fazer quando está cansado?
questions.english: What can you do today but cannot manage when tired?

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Which sentence expresses “May I come in?”? A. Você pode abrir a porta? B. Posso entrar? C. Eles conseguem correr rápido.
A_multiple_choice.worked_answer: B. Posso entrar? — compare the exact meaning, then read it aloud.

B_gap_fill.worked_answer: Posso → Posso entrar? — use the English hint and the rest of the sentence.

C_english_to_portuguese.worked_answer: Ela pode ajudar hoje. — identify the subject, choose the verb form, then say it.

D_portuguese_to_english.worked_answer: May I come in? — translate the meaning, not word for word.

E_reading_comprehension.instruction: Por que a irmã não pode sair?
E_reading_comprehension.worked_answer: Porque ela trabalha. — find the sentence in the text that gives the answer, then answer in a full sentence.

F_written_production.instruction: Write one new sentence with the target form, using “Nós conseguimos estudar juntos.” as a reference.
F_written_production.worked_answer: Model: Você pode abrir a porta? — change the information, keep the target structure correct.

G_speaking.instruction: Say one sentence with today’s structure about your own life.
G_speaking.worked_answer: Model: Eles conseguem correr rápido. — say it, then change one real-life detail.

your_homework.instruction: Give independent answers and speak all written sentences once.

A_multiple_choice.instruction: Choose the sentence with the given meaning.

items.prompt: Which sentence expresses “I can speak Portuguese.”?
Which sentence expresses “She can help today.”?
Which sentence expresses “We manage to study together.”?
Which sentence expresses “Can you open the door?”?
Which sentence expresses “They can run fast.”?

E_reading.instruction: Read the text and answer the questions in full sentences.
E_reading.text: Eu posso usar seu livro? Você pode, claro. Meu amigo consegue correr muito rápido. Eu não consigo correr tanto. Nós podemos caminhar juntos. Hoje ele consegue sair mais cedo do trabalho.
questions: O narrador pode usar o livro?
O que o amigo consegue fazer?
O que o amigo consegue fazer hoje?

F_written_production.instruction: Write 6–8 sentences on the topic “Things you can do and permission you need”. Use at least three different relevant examples of the target structure; add context and original details.

G_speaking.instruction: Record one uninterrupted spoken response to these three lesson prompts — Você consegue falar português? / Posso abrir a porta? / O que você consegue fazer bem? — giving complete sentences and without reading a script.

spaced_review.prompt: I am going to travel tomorrow.

teacher.pronunciation_focus: Listen for nasal vowel in consigo versus posso.

mini_reading.translation: Today I can study at home. My sister cannot go out because she works. She manages to study at night. My friend can speak Portuguese. Can you open the door? Yes, I can. We manage to finish the activity together.

F_written_production.assessment: Check length, topic relevance, at least three accurate uses of the target structure, and agreement. Personal details vary.

model_answers: Sim, você pode abrir a porta.

homework.acceptable_alternatives: A different accurate subject, name, or everyday example is acceptable in open speaking/writing tasks. For closed translation tasks, accept semantically equivalent natural Brazilian Portuguese with the target structure.
